SEC_Meme_CollectiveEgoist.descriptionMak.li: creation(tag=meme_SEC_Meme_Secretary_Nexus)->The secretaries led men and women in a great and distant world into a better era.

episode(tag=meme_SEC_Meme_Secretary_Nexus)->The secretaries told everyone, "No one can live apart from the social collective. Even in times without socialized production, people still worked and communicated within their own communities."

intro(tag=meme_SEC_Meme_Secretary_Nexus)->The common people of the Alfaus Peninsula labored together to the sound of united songs, building a monument belonging solely to the working people with countless miracles and eternal happiness. This, as the secretaries told them, is the true value of [memeConcept].

conflict(tag=meme_SEC_Meme_Secretary_Nexus)->The class enemy could not tolerate the common people living so happily in another society, and sent ruthless gene‑warriors and bio‑engineered war‑beasts to the Alfaus Peninsula to tear apart the great family of the common people with blood and fire.

founderJoin(tag=meme_SEC_Meme_Secretary_Nexus)->The secretaries set out alone for the apocalyptic battlefield to join the final war on that distant world. But the common people seized guns, built powerful war machines, and begged the secretaries to let them follow and fight — they could not endure being useless in the final struggle.

victory(tag=meme_SEC_Meme_Secretary_Nexus)->The actions of the secretaries united the common people. From victory to victory, the masses stormed the lair of the class enemy. Wave after wave, unstoppable, they finally wiped out the shadow government that sought to oppress the entire world, along with its evil artificial intelligence.

setup(tag=meme_SEC_Meme_Secretary_Nexus)->In a world of selfishness, the secretaries created a new set of production relations, uniting the common people through solid material incentives and gradual self‑managed practice.

story(tag=meme_SEC_Meme_Secretary_Nexus)->Some, unaware of how powerful this bond was, tried to break these production relations for personal gain. But the common people, keenly aware that their own interests were threatened, tore those foolish people apart, disregarding the secretaries’ moral pleas.
story(tag=meme_SEC_Meme_Secretary_Nexus)->Even the secretaries could not stop them from doing so. This was both a misfortune and a blessing.

lessonIntro(tag=meme_SEC_Meme_Secretary_Nexus)->Some enjoyed the benefits of collective labor but were unwilling to contribute. They were ruthlessly expelled from the collective by the common people. Some felt that this did not match their imagined utopia, but the secretaries explained:

lesson(tag=meme_SEC_Meme_Secretary_Nexus)->Social progress is not a simple gathering of the virtuous, nor is it saints and gods watching over their beloved people forever. Rather, it is the active and ruthless suppression by the majority, bound together by common interests, of the minority who encroach upon those interests.

lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_SEC_Meme_Secretary_Nexus)->If you can all remember that the most universal self‑interest has given rise to the greatest progress, and if you understand the most basic assumptions of historical materialism, then "we" will be fully satisfied.
archistBasis(tag=meme_SEC_Meme_Secretary_Nexus)->Archotechnology is the collective achievement of an ancient society.

archistFact(tag=meme_SEC_Meme_Secretary_Nexus)->The people who lived in that ancient, advanced society looked down on intelligent life living in a society torn apart by separated interests. They hoped that later generations, after forming an even greater community of interests, would use their technology for common causes rather than mutual slaughter.

archistProphecy(tag=meme_SEC_Meme_Secretary_Nexus)->In the end, the creators of archotechnology will accept who they deem worthy into the collective will, and walk among the stars together in eternal happiness.

animistFact(tag=meme_SEC_Meme_Secretary_Nexus)->Just as countless beings in nature depend on one another to keep the balance of the ecosystem forever sustained, people must also form interdependent relationships of interests in social progress, lest they perish alone in the cold void.
